added_lines: This weekend the friars and parish are observing Safeguarding Sunday . Every child and adult at risk deserves to be safe and treated with respect. This matters to all of us – Friars, staff, volunteers and parishioners. At all the Masses this weekend one of the Safeguarding representatives will be addressing those attending Mass, so you will all know who they are and what they look like. Fairview

Blessing with the relic of St Francis of Assisi, each Sunday Our Mass of Remembrance will take place on ; Friday the 13th of November at 7:30pm in our Church.
Every November we take time to remember our loved ones who have passed away and also those who grieve their absence.
Our Parish will be holding an annual Mass of Remembrance for all who died and were buried in the parish since this time last year.
Your presence, on such occasions lets people know that we have not forgotten them and that they are still in our thoughts and prayers.
So please come along to our Mass of Remembrance for your presence and your prayers will act as a support for all who have lost a loved one this past year.

November Remembrance Mass This Weekend 7th and 8th November , the SVP collection , will take place outside the Church doors, the collection aims to support families in our Parish, who are struggling to provide the essentials.
Please help SVP . Gospel Reflection: Matthew 25:1-13 : Jesus shares a parable about ten virgins waiting for a bridegroom.
Five are wise and bring extra oil, while five are foo lish and don’t.
When the bridegroom arrives, only the wise ones can join him in the wedding feast, as they are prepared.
